page.overview:
Who is Edwin?

Edwin is a fanatical Gangrel Alastor within the Camarilla and a member of The Bounty Hunters. He typically dresses in the style of a man in black from classic Western films and actively persecutes Caitiff and thin-blood vampires.

Edwin serves the Camarilla with extreme devotion. He operates under a strict personal mantra that prioritises his sect above his clan, and his clan above his coterie. This ruthless attitude earns him few allies, though his sire, Geoffrey Leigh, takes pride in his childe's zeal.

He briefly held the title of Prince of Pasadena. This praxis ended when the Anarch leader Jeremy MacNeil swore to kill him personally. Edwin maintains a fearsome reputation among the Anarchs, who circulate rumours that buzzards and crows begin circling right before he enters a domain.

As a highly capable scourge, Edwin successfully hunted and eliminated his first Anathema target in the 1980s. In the modern nights, he harbours a specific desire to hunt down and destroy Count Germaine.
